title: SOX NACK envelope body
description: Reserved body type for negative acknowledgement messages. A 'sox-nack' signals that the receiver received but cannot or will not process the referenced message. The sender may retry, escalate, or proceed under its current assumption. See spec/primitives/ack-nack.md for semantics.

correlation_id.description: The message_id (or caller-supplied correlation_id) of the message being negatively acknowledged.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason for the NACK. 'outside_domain': the request is outside the receiver's knowledge domain. 'receiver_busy': receiver cannot process before sender's decision point. 'malformed_request': request body is missing required fields or is structurally invalid. 'missing_context': insufficient context to produce a useful answer. 'rate_limited': receiver is applying its own rate limit. 'other': use detail field for explanation.

detail.description: Optional. Human-readable explanation of the NACK. Required when reason_code is 'other'.

retry_after.description: Optional. Unix epoch seconds after which the sender MAY retry the request. Null or absent means no specific retry guidance.

examples.detail: Currently processing a blocking file write; retry after checkpoint.
